name: cost-file-doctor
author: Lxb
description_zh: 拿到造价软件工程文件先诊断再动手：识别格式归属、判定是否加密、评估可解析性，给出本地解析/装原软件/找现成导出件三条路径，内置分页表头清理器。
description_en: Diagnose cost-engineering files before parsing: vendor format, encryption status, and the cheapest viable path, plus a paged-header spreadsheet cleaner.
